prompts.label: Engine and first connection
prompts.text:
I'm new to SQLAlchemy 2.x. Set up a minimal script with create_engine for SQLite file app.db.

- Test connection with engine.connect() and SELECT 1
- Explain the role of the Engine vs Session
- requirements.txt with sqlalchemy>=2

No ORM models yet — Core only in this step.

prompts.label: Declarative Base model
prompts.text:
Create a DeclarativeBase and a User model with id, email (unique), created_at.

- Use Mapped[] and mapped_column (SQLAlchemy 2.0 style)
- metadata.create_all(engine) for dev only
- Show the generated table shape in words

Single module models.py and short comments.

prompts.label: Sessionmaker and session scope
prompts.text:
Wire SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine) and use with SessionLocal() as session.

- Explain commit, rollback, close lifecycle
- Why autocommit=False default matters
- Insert one User and commit

Contrast session per request vs global session anti-pattern.

prompts.label: INSERT and SELECT with select()
prompts.text:
Teach CRUD with SQLAlchemy 2.0 select() style (not legacy Query).

- session.add(), session.get(User, id)
- select(User).where(User.email == ...)
- scalars().all() vs scalar_one_or_none()

Provide runnable script with print outputs.

prompts.label: UPDATE and DELETE rows
prompts.text:
Show updating a field and deleting by id using session.get and session.delete.

- Use update(User).where(...) with session.execute for bulk update (one example)
- Explain when ORM unit of work vs Core execute fits
- Commit and verify row count changed

Keep SQLite example.

prompts.label: One-to-many relationship
prompts.text:
Model Author and Post with relationship() and ForeignKey.

- back_populates on both sides
- Create author with two posts in one session
- Query author.posts from loaded instance

Explain lazy='select' default briefly and N+1 teaser.

prompts.label: Many-to-many association table
prompts.text:
Add Student, Course, and association table student_course.

- relationship(secondary=...) pattern
- Enroll student in two courses
- Query students for a course

Show Table() association definition explicitly.

prompts.label: joinedload avoid N+1
prompts.text:
Demonstrate N+1 when loading many posts without joinedload, then fix with selectinload or joinedload.

- Use sqlalchemy.orm attributes
- Print query count intuition (explain without heavy logging libs)
- One before/after code sketch

Beginner-friendly explanation of eager loading.

prompts.label: Alembic init and first revision
prompts.text:
Initialize Alembic for an existing SQLAlchemy project.

- alembic init, configure sqlalchemy.url and target_metadata
- Create first revision with upgrade creating tables
- Commands: upgrade head, downgrade -1

Assume models metadata is importable in env.py.

prompts.label: Autogenerate migration after model change
prompts.text:
Add a nullable column to User, then alembic revision --autogenerate.

- Review generated ops before applying
- Explain why autogenerate is not magic on data migrations
- upgrade head workflow

List one case autogenerate misses (rename column).

prompts.label: Async engine and asyncpg
prompts.text:
Set up create_async_engine with postgresql+asyncpg:// (or aiosqlite for simpler local demo).

- AsyncSession with async_sessionmaker
- async with session.begin() pattern
- One async select and print

Note when async SA helps (FastAPI) vs sync simplicity for scripts.

prompts.label: FastAPI Depends get_db session
prompts.text:
Wire SQLAlchemy session into FastAPI with Depends yielding session and closing after request.

- Generator dependency try/finally or contextlib
- One GET route listing users from DB
- Explain transaction per request

Minimal main.py + models.py structure.

prompts.label: Indexes and unique constraints
prompts.text:
Add index=True and UniqueConstraint on model fields.

- Explain difference index vs unique
- Show __table_args__ for composite unique (email + tenant_id)
- How Alembic picks this up on autogenerate

SQLite example is fine.

prompts.label: Hybrid property on model
prompts.text:
Add a hybrid_property full_name combining first and last on a Person model.

- Show Python-side access
- Mention hybrid_expression for SQL queries at high level
- When @property is enough instead

Small demo with two Person rows.

prompts.label: Connection pool settings
prompts.text:
Explain create_engine pool_size, max_overflow, pool_pre_ping for Postgres deployments.

- What happens when pool is exhausted
- Why pre_ping helps after idle DB disconnects
- Defaults are fine for SQLite dev

No Kubernetes — just DBA-minded defaults checklist.

prompts.label: Raw SQL with text() safely
prompts.text:
Show executing raw SQL with sqlalchemy.text and bound parameters (never f-string SQL).

- SELECT with :id parameter
- When to drop to raw SQL vs ORM
- Map rows to dicts with .mappings()

One reporting query example.

prompts.label: pytest fixture test database
prompts.text:
Set up pytest fixture with SQLite in-memory engine and session per test.

- Rollback after each test for isolation
- Factory helper create_user(session)
- One test asserting query count

Prefer pytest; mention unittest briefly.

prompts.label: Flask-SQLAlchemy vs pure SA
prompts.text:
Compare Flask-SQLAlchemy extension vs manual Session in Flask app factory.

- db.Model convenience vs explicit Base
- When beginners should start pure SQLAlchemy for learning
- Link mental model: extension wraps session scope

No full app — decision guide + tiny code contrast.

prompts.label: Soft delete with query filter
prompts.text:
Add deleted_at nullable datetime to a model and default queries excluding soft-deleted rows.

- Option A: custom query helper
- Option B: with_loader_criteria or event listener mention at high level
- Unique constraints with soft delete caveat

Practical pattern for beginners.

prompts.label: Seed script and bulk insert
prompts.text:
Write scripts/seed.py populating demo data with session.add_all and commit.

- Idempotent seed: check count before insert or upsert pattern sketch
- Use Faker optional for names
- Run with python -m scripts.seed

Explain bulk_insert_mappings when performance matters.
